es: Escribir un informe breve sobre un rumor del barrio con there is said to be, it is rumoured that y una estructura con sujeto personal, sin afirmar de más.

teaching.en: There is said to be a strange light in the abandoned house.
teaching.es: Se dice que hay una luz extraña en la casa abandonada.
teaching.explanationEs: There is said to be + singular: presenta como rumor que algo existe.
segments: There is said to be a
strange light in the abandoned house.
teaching.audioText: There is said to be a strange light in the abandoned house.

teaching.en: There are thought to be three secret rooms in the basement.
teaching.es: Se piensa que hay tres salas secretas en el sótano.
teaching.explanationEs: There are thought to be + plural: el verbo be concuerda con lo que sigue.
segments: There are thought to be three
teaching.audioText: There are thought to be three secret rooms in the basement.

teaching.en: There is believed to have been a fire in the abandoned cinema.
teaching.es: Se cree que hubo un incendio en el cine abandonado.
teaching.explanationEs: to have been: el rumor habla de algo que existió o pasó antes.
segments: There is believed to have been
a fire in the abandoned cinema.
teaching.audioText: There is believed to have been a fire in the abandoned cinema.

teaching.en: It is rumoured that the owner has left the country.

teaching.en: The owner is reported to have heard noises at night.

teaching.explanationEs: Sujeto personal + is reported to have + participio: algo que ocurrió antes.
teaching.audioText: The owner is reported to have heard noises at night.

teaching.en: There is no proof, and the neighbours have not confirmed it.

teaching.audioText: There is no proof, and the neighbours have not confirmed it.

prompt.es: Escribe un informe de 100 a 150 palabras sobre un rumor de tu barrio.

answer.text: There is a rumour in our neighbourhood about the old cinema on Main Street. Nobody goes inside now, and the windows are always dark. There is said to be a strange light in the basement at night, and some neighbours say they have heard noises. It is rumoured that the owner has left the country because of a secret. The owner is thought to have closed the cinema after a fire many years ago. There are believed to be old films in the basement too. However, nobody has confirmed any of this. There is no proof, and the owner has not answered our questions. For now, it is only a story, and we must be careful before we repeat it.
accepted: There is a rumour in our neighbourhood about the old cinema on Main Street. Nobody goes inside now, and the windows are always dark. There is said to be a strange light in the basement at night, and some neighbours say they have heard noises. It is rumoured that the owner has left the country because of a secret. The owner is thought to have closed the cinema after a fire many years ago. There are believed to be old films in the basement too. However, nobody has confirmed any of this. There is no proof, and the owner has not answered our questions. For now, it is only a story, and we must be careful before we repeat it.

Everybody in my street talks about the abandoned house at the end of the road. There is said to be a light in the basement at night, and there are thought to be secret rooms under the garden. It is rumoured that the owner has sold the house to a stranger. The owner is reported to have heard strange noises before he left. The neighbours say the story is very old, but there is no proof. Nobody has confirmed anything, and nobody has seen the owner this year. Until somebody checks the facts, it is only a rumour, and we should not repeat it as if it were true.

feedback.es: El informe mezcla tres estructuras impersonales y cierra con una nota de cautela para no afirmar de más.

origin.text: Elige un lugar de tu barrio (una casa, un cine o una tienda). Cuenta el rumor con tres estructuras distintas: there is/are said to be, it is rumoured that y una frase con sujeto personal (is thought to have…). Cierra con una frase neutral.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase convierte «It is said that the owner has sold the shop»?

choices.text: The owner is said to sell the shop.
The owner is said that he has sold the shop.
The owner is said to have sold the shop.

feedback.es: Sujeto personal + is said to have + participio: el sujeto pasa al inicio y se quitan it y that.
